'''Sablix Veen''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] fashion designer and model<ref name="SoloOG" /> who in [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Vandor]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the party aboard ''[[First Light]]'' attended by Sablix Veen while it was moored on [[Vandor]] must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> attended a party aboard ''[[First Light]]'', the star [[yacht]] of [[Crimson Dawn]]'s leader [[Dryden Vos]] while the [[Starship|ship]] was moored on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]].<ref name="Solo" /> She hoped her appearance at the party would boost her career.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sablix Veen first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
